_comment: Prototype fixes (2026-11-14), replay after names/protos_fix_1.json with tools/apply_logic_protos.py names/protos_fix_2.json. _ftol (MSVC 6 runtime, LUA.DLL's and the EXE's) converts the x87 value in ST0: with the operand declared in ST0 the decompiler shows what is converted (`_ftol((float10)PUN(float,o->dwValue))`), which build_src.py's fix_ftol turns into FTOL(...). Before, the calls were `_ftol()` and the functions around them were hand-written. With the EXE's _ftol in ST0 two prototypes moved on re-export and are stored: rdClip_Line2's canvas as int (sweep_protos had undefined4, which the decompiler re-typed float), sputLua_ImSetSequence as a Lua C function (void)(void) (the __fastcall parameter was the lost x87 value).

00446c10.proto: undefined4 rdClip_Line2(int canvas, undefined4 *x0, undefined4 *y0, undefined4 *x1, undefined4 *y1)
